QuestInfo.name: The Magician's Next Journey
QuestInfo.0: Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Magician, I feel the urge to learn more.
QuestInfo.1: Does #b#p313##k of #b#m10002000##k have even greater lessons to teach me?
QuestInfo.2: #b#p313##k said that if I can pass his test, he'll gladly teach me more. I'm no longer the weakling I once was, but hearing that I still have to face a trial makes me a bit nervous.

0.0: Finally, I've reached level 30! It hasn't been easy, but now I'm confident I can stand as a true Magician who won't lose to anyone. Still... Is this really enough? The world is vast, and I find myself wanting to learn more.
0.1: I should probably visit #b#p313##k in #b#m10002000##k again. He might be able to teach me something new.

1.0: Aren't you that beginner from before? I can see in your bright eyes that the fear you once had is long gone.
1.1: There's no need for a long explanation. You want to learn more, don't you? Seeing young people like you... now I'm motivated.
1.2: But first, I need to see if you're truly ready. If you're prepared to take my test, come speak to me again.
